stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Low 60s in play Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

stories.title: Portland's Commercial Street plans lane reduction amid storm drain upgrade
stories.summary: Portland's storm drain project enters Phase Two, narrowing Commercial Street to one lane, affecting drivers.

stories.title: Nurses accuse Prime Healthcare of aggressive union-busting at public town hall in Lewiston
stories.summary: Nurses at Central Maine Medical Center accuse Prime Healthcare of union-busting and unsafe staffing levels, urging reinstatement and potential strike action.

stories.title: Portland's Back Cove Festival canceled permanently
stories.summary: Portland's Back Cove Festival, debuting in August 2025, will not return in 2027.

stories.title: South Portland cyber attack keeps City Hall, library closed as residents turn to paper payments
stories.summary: A suspected cyber attack continues to disrupt South Portland services, keeping City Hall and the library closed as residents find alternatives for everyday business.

stories.title: Wilton board set to vote on proposed code of conduct
stories.summary: The proposal, which revises the current code, includes procedures for the board to manage conflicts of interest, abstention from votes and censure of board members.

stories.title: RSU 73 directors send request to set student progress goals to the district’s policy committee
stories.summary: Directors took no action on a call for the superintendent to provide monthly costs for legal bills connected with the Maine Human Rights Commission lawsuit.

stories.title: Portland unveils new pedestrian pathway, linking Bayside and Parkside neighborhoods
stories.summary: The new Union Branch Pathway includes 12 feet of both paved and stone dust paths, enhanced safety lighting, and stormwater management features.

stories.title: 10 rescued chinchillas arrive in Maine, ready for new homes
stories.summary: Ten chinchillas rescued from an Ohio breeding facility are now up for adoption at the Animal Welfare Society in Kennebunk.

stories.title: Maine electricity supply rates increasing in 2027 for many CMP, Versant customers
stories.summary: For the average residential customer of Central Maine Power, the increase will amount to about $4.99 per month

stories.title: High fuel costs hit Maine plow operators ahead of winter
stories.summary: Private companies, towns, and the state are all paying more for diesel this season, and some are passing the costs along.

stories.title: Route 164 bridge closure in Caribou extended into 2027
stories.summary: Supply delays have pushed back construction on the Prestile Brook Bridge, keeping Route 164 closed through winter and spring.
